name: Waza College
description: Waza College — a theme for a vocational training college, built as an audience gateway under a formal centred white header: the college name in the centre, the Apply button at the right and the menu centred on a second row. Rust asagi (#6699A1) is the main colour: the path detail section, the apply steps, every page head and the mobile menu are rust-asagi fields in ink type. The front page opens on white with one centred headline and three equal framed panels (from high school, changing career, for employers), each with a transparent cut-out photograph (toolbox, laptop, hard hat) breaking out of the frame top edge; then one short two-column section per path, twelve courses in an asymmetric masonry with a field filter, outcomes with three large figures and partner employers, a dated list of open days and three application steps in one row. Photographs are realistic high-key images (85mm, softbox light, near-white backgrounds, graded toward rust asagi). BIZ UDPGothic for headings, Manrope for text and figures. Sample content in English. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
